svg.text: TPS2121 battery selector | comparator lockout and MCU monitoring
Dedicated 1S battery preferred; main 1-4S battery requires MCU permission. Resistor calculations and limitations: README.md.
PROTOTYPE CONNECTION GUIDE | Same net label = same wire. Read README.md before implementation.
Junction dot = connected. Wire jump = NOT connected. All ground symbols share GND. 3V3 comes from the independent MCU buck/USB power path.
R1-R4 and R13-R16: 0.1%. Other resistors: 1%. Nominal 3.5 V cutoff only; reference tolerance and power sequencing remain design constraints.
USB never connects to IN1/IN2/OUT. Source selection is not arming. Inert-load verification required before implementation.
